event: First grid oscillation emerges (0.63 Hz) in southwestern Iberia
voltage_condition: Voltage swings reach ±30 kV on 400 kV lines
simulator_notes: PLL instability in low-SCR southern zone begins

event: HVDC Santa Llogaia-Baixas switched to constant power (P) mode

voltage_condition: Iberian block swings against Continental Europe. Voltage < 420 kV
simulator_notes: Bulk system oscillation. Control room monitoring extreme conditions

event: System temporarily stable, no active alarms
voltage_condition: 400 kV network voltage strictly maintained < 420 kV (upper regulatory limit)
simulator_notes: Deceptive calm before initiating event. Network is at electrical edge

event: INITIATING EVENT: Massive generation trip in southern Spain (Granada, Badajoz, Seville)
voltage_condition: Voltage begins spike (paradoxical: loss of generation → overvoltage, not undervoltage)
simulator_notes: MV-connected renewables trip due to overvoltage protection on 400/220 kV autotransformers. Reactive power sink vanishes. Ferranti effect begins.

voltage_condition: Voltage continues rising. 400 kV buses approach 425 kV
simulator_notes: ROCOF = 0.75 Hz/s. Remaining synchronous units (3.3 GW nuclear) provide primary control but insufficient

voltage_condition: Voltage spike continues. 400 kV approaching 430+ kV (exceeding all regulatory limits)
simulator_notes: System enters critical zone. ROCOF > 0.8 Hz/s. Remaining generation margin exhausted

event: UFLS Stage 1 activates at 49.0 Hz threshold. ~3.1 GW load shed (first 5 stages)
voltage_condition: Paradox: UFLS sheds load → line currents drop → Ferranti effect worsens → voltage spikes further to 435+ kV
simulator_notes: CRITICAL: UFLS accelerates collapse. Overvoltage protection on remaining renewables begins cascading trips

event: Loss of synchronism between Iberian and French networks detected
voltage_condition: Voltage collapse in southern zones > 440 kV. Distance relays 'protection blind' due to low IBR fault current
simulator_notes: AC interconnection tielines trip (3-phase outage at Pyrenees border). Loss of 4.6 GW imports. Remaining synchronous units detect pole-slip condition

event: Remaining nuclear and thermal units trip on ROCOF and pole-slip protection
voltage_condition: Voltage collapse reaches lowest point: some zones < 380 kV (brownout phase)
simulator_notes: Once > 1.0 Hz/s ROCOF threshold reached, synchronous machines self-protect to prevent shaft damage. Cascade becomes unstoppable

event: HVDC Santa Llogaia-Baixas link trips. Total blackout of Iberian synchronous area
voltage_condition: HVDC converter station control loses synchronous reference. Link disabled
simulator_notes: Total collapse. Iberian Peninsula completely decoupled from Continental Europe. 31 GW load lost. 56-60 million people without power
